entities.name: Báetán mac Ninneda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Báetán mac Ninneda was an Irish king of the Cenél Conaill, a sept of the northern Uí Néill. He was the son of Ninnid mac Duach and great grandson of Conall Gulban. He was a member of the Cenél nDuach branch of the Cenél Conaill. He is counted as King of Tara in some sources.
